text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder turns heads in her<n>debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And yet, the media only see her as<n>the next
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As if to fan the flames, Grass Wonder<n>declares her
intentions to run in the<n>Asahi Hai F.S., where
Maruzensky<n>set an all-time record.
